title: Covariant scalar-tensor theories beyond second derivatives
summary: We propose a covariant, gauge-independent construction of foliation-based scalar-tensor theories, yielding diffeomorphism-invariant operators involving only gradients on the hypersurfaces where the scalar field is constant, assumed to be spacelike. This defines a basis of independent invariants up to four derivatives of $φ$, including the first nontrivial parity-odd pseudoscalar at this order, with a straightforward extension to higher derivatives.
